definitions.gloss: time, passage of time, months and days
definitions.explanation: The passing of time, often with a nuance of a considerable period having elapsed. Emphasizes the accumulation of days and months.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{月日|つきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: Many years have passed since graduation.

examples.japanese: {月日|つきひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧⟦とともに→共に：03468_tomoni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{癒|い}えた→癒える：20856_ieru⟧。
examples.english: The wounds healed with the passage of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{月日|つきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{慣|な}れない→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A long time has passed since I came to Japan, but there are still things I'm not used to.

examples.japanese: {月日|つきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦につれて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{薄|うす}れて→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: As time passed, the memories of that day gradually faded.

notes:
USAGE: {月日|つきひ} emphasizes the passing of time over an extended period. It has a somewhat literary or reflective nuance.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {月日|つきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ (time passes)
- {月日|つきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (time flows by)
- {月日|つきひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧ (passage of time)

READING NOTE: Can also be read as がっぴ in compound words like ⟦{生年月日|せいねんがっぴ}→生年月日：03293_seinengappi⟧ (date of birth), but {月日|つきひ} when used alone to mean 'passage of time.'

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧ (time passes - general)
- ⟦{年月|としつき}→年月：03458_toshitsuki⟧/⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧ (years, passage of time)
